item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem: Meera's mother is choosing a packaged evening snack for the family. She compares the nutrition labels of two foods, given per 100 g. Food P has 530 kcal, 33 g fat, 6 g protein and 4 g dietary fibre. Food Q has 360 kcal, 7 g fat, 18 g protein and 15 g dietary fibre. Junk foods are high in calories and fat but low in protein and dietary fibre. Which statement correctly identifies the food that better fits the junk-food pattern?

options.A: Food P, because it has more calories and fat but less protein and dietary fibre
options.B: Food Q, because its higher dietary fibre makes it more filling
options.C: Food Q, because it has more protein per 100 g
options.D: Both foods fit the junk-food pattern equally, since both are packaged foods
